summary: Puzzle Difficulty Progression feature tested - 12/13 backend tests pass, all UI components working correctly. Rating card shows correct values, rating changes work, streaks update properly, achievements badge visible. Level-up modal and achievement toasts are correctly implemented in code.

puzzle_rating_card_display.description: Puzzle Rating card displays on Training page sidebar with data-testid='puzzle-rating-card'

rating_starts_at_1200.description: New users start with rating 1200 (DEFAULT_PUZZLE_RATING in puzzle_progression_service.py)

correct_answer_increases_rating.description: API returns positive rating_change on correct answers (tested +29 on correct Nd5 move)

incorrect_answer_decreases_rating.description: API returns negative rating_change on incorrect answers (tested -3, -5 on wrong moves)

rating_change_badge_in_code.description: Rating change badge with data-testid='rating-change-badge' is in TrainingNew.jsx lines 659-665 (correct) and 727-733 (incorrect). Shows +X or -X based on feedback.progression.rating_change

streak_increments_on_correct.description: current_streak increments on correct answers (progression.current_streak returned by API)

streak_resets_on_incorrect.description: current_streak resets to 0 on incorrect answers (verified in API test)

level_up_modal_in_code.description: Level-up modal with data-testid='level-up-modal' implemented in TrainingNew.jsx lines 1127-1218. Shows when progression.leveled_up is true

achievement_toasts_in_code.description: Achievement toasts implemented in TrainingNew.jsx lines 329-338. Shows toast for each new_achievement

progress_bar_to_next_level.description: Progress bar shows points_to_next_level (e.g., '310 points to Advanced')

puzzle_progress_api.description: Returns puzzle_rating, current_level, level_label, current_streak, total_puzzles, solve_rate, best_streak, achievements

puzzle_validate_api.description: Returns correct/incorrect with progression object containing rating_change, leveled_up, new_achievements, current_streak

puzzle_difficulty_recommendation.description: Returns user_rating and recommended_difficulties based on Elo

puzzle_leaderboard.description: Returns leaderboard array of top puzzle solvers

critical_code_review_comments: puzzle_progression_service.py: Well-implemented Elo rating system with K_FACTOR=32, proper level boundaries, achievement tracking
TrainingNew.jsx: Rating card fully functional with all data-testid attributes, progression state updates correctly
server.py lines 6051-6140: Puzzle progress endpoints properly integrate with puzzle_progression_service

seed_data_creation: Multiple puzzle attempts recorded during testing (14 puzzles attempted, 7 solved)
